item: row 408 PR 3: imported articles are screened in the background (R827 R10, R830 groups A+B)
summary: A restore queues the articles it adds (screening_pending, written in the working copy before the swap) instead of screening them in its own window; a background worker judges them with the same rules after the run lets go of the machine (one commit per chunk: stamps, counter shift, queue rows removed). The junk stamp is set-based with the counter shift taken from the rows each chunk actually changed. Every aggregate leaves queued articles out through not_counted / NOT_COUNTED_SQL; counter-served readers subtract the queued share at query time because index_article is under the engine-digest hold. Home strip and import report say N articles not screened yet. Bench numbers are in the PR body.
